plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps at one month of Fees paid 'without exception', which conflicts with the Excluded Claims regime in 21.3 and falls far below any acceptable cap — likely deviation. Assess 21.2-21.4 as supporting carve-out language.

Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-gives indemnity (20.1) covering 'every claim relating in any way' to use; no Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity appears, though Sec 9.3 cross-references a Section 20.5 remedy that is not in the outline. Check for missing Vendor indemnity plus overbroad Customer indemnity.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month post-term worldwide non-compete on Customer — squarely prohibited; note the direct conflict with Sec 12.3, which disclaims any such commitment.
Sec 2.2 (first of two 2.2s) makes Vendor the sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics — deviation; Sec 12.3 is the countervailing freedom-of-supply language to cite.
No MFN obligation on Customer located; Sec 12.3 expressly disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment. Confirm nothing in pricing sections (7.1, 8.3) imposes one.
No non-solicit binding Customer found; Sec 12.3 preserves hiring via general recruitment and disclaims a no-hire commitment. Sweep Section 12 and 30.1 to confirm.

Sec 9.4 gives Customer 30-day convenience termination with prepaid-fee refund and denies Vendor a reciprocal right — favourable, likely compliant. Note tension with the Sec 2.1 take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights' (handle under MINCOMMIT).
Sec 8.2 gives a 30-day non-renewal window plus a 60-day reminder with deadline extension; Sec 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice. Likely compliant.
New York law and exclusive New York County courts, no foreign arbitration — within accepted list; likely compliant.
Sec 24.1 permits Customer assignment to Affiliates/successors without consent; 24.2 restricts Vendor; 24.4 blocks Vendor termination or repricing on our change of control. Likely compliant.

Sec 14.1-14.2 give Customer ownership of Customer Data and Deliverables with assignment from Vendor; 14.3/14.4 handle Vendor Technology, joint IP and feedback. Check that no clause assigns our IP or data to Vendor (see 15.1 processing limits).

Sec 13.1 grants a Customer-only, non-transferable licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and excludes Affiliates and contractors — deviation. Sec 13.2/13.3 provide contrasting perpetual/Affiliate and anti-revocation language to leverage.
Sec 22.1-22.3 limit Vendor audits to once yearly, 30 days' notice, off-site where practicable, Vendor-borne cost subject to a 5% underpayment shift, with data-access limits. Likely compliant.

No liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer identified; Sec 7.3 bars interest on amounts not due and Sec 9.4 termination is penalty-free. The Sec 2.1 take-or-pay is commercially adjacent but belongs to MINCOMMIT — do not double-flag.

Sec 19.2 limits the Deliverable conformity warranty to fifteen days with no correction or refund obligation thereafter — likely deviation on duration; read with the 19.4 remedy and 19.1 ongoing services warranty.
Sec 18.1 lists CGL, workers' comp, employer's liability, E&O and USD 5M cyber cover for the term plus one year; 18.2 adds certificates and non-limitation. Likely compliant.

Sec 2.1 imposes a USD 2M/year three-year take-or-pay expressly 'without reduction or termination rights' — deviation; note conflict with Sec 9.4 convenience termination and Sec 12.3's disclaimer of minimum-volume commitments.

Sec 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion with no export or migration support — deviation, and it contradicts Sec 11.2/11.3 (30-day machine-readable return, certified deletion). Target 11.1 and reconcile with 10.1-10.2.
